The '''98th Elite Mechanized''' was a unit of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Army/Legends|ground forces]]. The 98th used [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Series]] [[TIE crawler/Legends|century tanks]] with [[Color/Legends|blue]] livery, and were considered elite.<ref name="Pocket" />

==Behind the scenes==
A 98th Elite Mechanized century tank miniature labeled as a "TIE Crawler"&mdash;another name for the compact assault vehicle&mdash;was featured in the ''[[Ground Assault]]'' expansion of the ''[[Star Wars PocketModel TCG]]'', released [[November 14]], [[2007]].<ref name="Game Site">{{WizKids|url=StarWars/newsandextras/newstemplate.aspx?id=4044|text=GROUND ASSAULT AVAILABLE IN STORES NOW!}}</ref>
